aub_upgrade_chain_ijil_mines_01_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = ijil_mines_01
			aub_can_upgrade_to_ijil_mines_02_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_4_cost }
		}
		remove_building = ijil_mines_01
		scope:aub_payer = { save_scope_as = character }
		add_special_building = ijil_mines_02
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = ijil_mines_02 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_4_cost }
		}
		else = {
			scope:aub_payer = { save_scope_as = character }
			add_special_building = ijil_mines_01
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = ijil_mines_02
			aub_can_upgrade_to_ijil_mines_03_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_5_cost }
		}
		remove_building = ijil_mines_02
		scope:aub_payer = { save_scope_as = character }
		add_special_building = ijil_mines_03
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = ijil_mines_03 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_5_cost }
		}
		else = {
			scope:aub_payer = { save_scope_as = character }
			add_special_building = ijil_mines_02
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = ijil_mines_03
			aub_can_upgrade_to_ijil_mines_04_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_6_cost }
		}
